summary: Clarifies the intent boundary for Argo harness environment initialization and Neo4j projection configuration: `node .argo/scripts/ensureArgoHarnessEnvironment.js` must load the exact approved `.argo/.env` into `process.env` before projection/runtime checks, and Neo4j configuration must use canonical `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_*` names rather than legacy aliases.
notes: Selected viewpoint: Requirements Realization Viewpoint. Stakeholder concern: runtime owners, ICT architects, requirements managers, and acceptors need harness environment loading and canonical Neo4j configuration names to be explicit release requirements before projection or database side effects.

View binding: `grag-native-embedding-release-requirements` remains a Requirements Realization Viewpoint instance because it traces configuration and credential constraints to the existing runtime and native retrieval realization path, now including canonical harness `.argo/.env` loading and rejection of legacy Neo4j aliases.

Coverage matrix: `grag-credential-boundary` functional point `functionalPoint.TS-07` -> `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07`; `functionalPoint.TS-07-provider-secret-isolation` -> `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation`; `functionalPoint.TS-07-canonical-neo4j-env-names` -> existing `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07` and existing `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation`.

Acceptance approval: the human partner constrained approval with `prefer extending existing testcases; do not add new testcases unless extension is impossible`. The graph now records this as schema-compliant extension approval on existing `acceptanceApproval.TS-01`, `acceptanceApproval.TS-07`, and `acceptanceApproval.TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation`; no new ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase remains in this handoff scope.

Acceptance boundary extension: existing `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-01` must also prove exact `.argo/.env` loading into `process.env`, root/alternate `.env` rejection, and process precedence/conflict behavior delegated to the credential boundary.

Acceptance boundary extension: existing `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07` and `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation` must also prove canonical `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL`, `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_USERNAME`, and `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD` are accepted while legacy `ARGO_NEO4J_URI`, `ARGO_NEO4J_USERNAME`, and `ARGO_NEO4J_PASSWORD` never satisfy or override required configuration.

Downstream ImplementationDesign should extend the existing physical entrypoints `tests/explicit/entries/runProductionGraphRagRuntime.js`, `tests/explicit/entries/runExternalCredentialBoundary.js`, and `tests/explicit/entries/runLiveEmbeddingProviderSecretIsolation.js` where feasible, preserving existing secret non-disclosure rules. Intent Design did not read, create, or output `.argo/.env` secret values.
